about-strip.heading: Our story
How it started
Why we do this
about-strip.body: We started making dog food at home when our own dog refused everything on the shelf. Turns out most pets feel the same way about real food.
Every recipe is developed with a veterinary nutritionist and tested by a panel of very enthusiastic dogs.
We believe pet food should be made the same way you would cook for yourself: real ingredients, no shortcuts.

faq.heading: Common questions

faq.items.question: Is this suitable for puppies?
faq.items.answer: The chicken and turkey recipes are approved for all life stages, including puppies from eight weeks.

faq.items.question: How should I store it?
faq.items.answer: Keep refrigerated. Each pack stays fresh for five days once opened.

faq.items.question: Do you deliver nationwide?
faq.items.answer: Yes. Chilled courier, next working day. Free on orders over thirty pounds.

faq.items.question: Can I change or cancel a subscription?
faq.items.answer: Any time, no penalty. Adjust, pause or cancel from your account page.
